ImageDescription.value: Captioned as "Uller". Leaning on a bow and wearing ice skates, the god Ullr stands atop a frozen lake. In the background stands a building and evergreen trees. The location is presumably the yew dale Ýdalir where Ullr has a dwelling as described in the Poetic Edda poem Grímnismál.

Credit.value: Wägner, Wilhelm. 1882. Nordisch-germanische Götter und Helden. Otto Spamer, Leipzig & Berlin. Page 190.
